title: AMH Agent Action
description: One turn of a model's response inside agents/harness/agentic_loop.py's ReAct-style tool-calling protocol (see _SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE) — the model's entire response every turn must be exactly one of these, per §11's 'Invalid model/tool output | contract validator' recovery-ownership row. Deliberately permissive on args' internal shape: per-tool argument validation (built-in tools against a fixed schema, MCP tools against the tool's own server-declared input_schema) happens as a separate step in agentic_loop.py, not here — this schema only pins down the envelope every action must have.
